points.label: Claimed rights
points.left: Paul grounds apostolic rights in work, law, and the Lord’s command. 1 Corinthians 9:1–14 belongs to Corinth and contested apostleship.
points.right: Ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape. 2 Corinthians 11:22–33 belongs to Corinth and contested apostleship.

points.label: Chosen restraint and weakness
points.left: Paul grounds apostolic rights in work, law, and the Lord’s command. Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord? Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
points.right: Ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape. Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I. I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

payload.posture: Inspect what each source actually says before relating their chronology, argument, or remembered scene.
